# netbox_token (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/rest-api/authentication/#tokens):

> A token is a unique identifier mapped to a NetBox user account. Each user may have one or more tokens which he or she can use for authentication when making REST API requests. To create a token, navigate to the API tokens page under your user profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_user" "test" {
  username = "johndoe"
  password = "Abcdefghijkl1"
}

resource "netbox_token" "test_basic" {
  user_id       = netbox_user.test.id
  key           = "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789"
  allowed_ips   = ["2.4.8.16/32"]
  write_enabled = false
  expires       = "2036-01-02T15:04:05.000Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the token.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) The allowed ips of the token.
- `description` (String) A description of the token.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token is enabled. A disabled token is revoked but not deleted. Needs NetBox 4.5 or later.
- `expires` (String) The expires of the token.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key of the token.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) Whether write enabled is enabled for the token.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_used` (String) The last used of the token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_token.example 1
```
